Second, it misinterpreted the path structure, assuming only 4 rolls instead of the correct 6, and misidentified roll directions (forward/right vs. left/backward). Third, it failed to correctly simulate the kinematics of cube rolling, leading to an incorrect final top face (purple instead of blue). The model also confused static rotation (0:07–0:12) with dynamic rolling (0:14 onward), further distorting its temporal understanding of the event sequence.
